services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Do you want to make new friends, hike, canoe, kayak, try archery, craft, play, tell tall tales, swim, sing and discover the wonders of Cumberland Lake Park this summer? Join our experienced camp leaders for our week-long camps in July and August. We promise you will leave each day tired and inspired. Check out our Summer Camp Welcome Package for more information. Wriggler Camp is an invitation to our youngest campers. We will explore the beautiful forests and beaches at Cumberland Lake Park at a slower pace than our Scamper and Rambler Camps. Lake Park Society offers full-day, BC Curriculum-aligned outdoor education programs in May and June. Each grade-specific program is developed by BC-certified teachers to inspire inquiry, build core competencies, and strengthen students’ connection to place. We gratefully acknowledge that our programs take place on the unceded traditional territory of the Pentlatch, E’iksan, Sasitla and Sathloot people, known today as the K’ómox First Nation. services.name: Equipment Rentals
services.desc: We believe the outdoors should be accessible to everyone and proudly provide inclusive recreation equipment at no cost. This equipment has been made possible with the generous support of Wachiay Friendship Society, Comox Valley Community Foundation and the Enabling Accessibility Fund. Equipment is available for use between the months of May and September, 10am to 6pm. Everyone can enjoy the water with the Onit Ability Board, generously donated by Wachiay Friendship Centre. It can be paddled independently, seated in the wheelchair provided or standing. The outrigger system is highly effective and offers paddlers confidence out on the water.
